headline: e-mans revenge strikes the vein for 181.46; Long Howie still unbeaten
lede: Week 5 came in loud, pardner. e-mans revenge put 181.46 on the board, the biggest haul in the territory, while Zihuatanejo limped home with 57.15 and not much to show the banker. Long Howie is the last wagon on the trail without a scratch at 5-0, and four outfits rode off with the commissioner's silver.
paragraphs: e-mans revenge hitched Matthew Stafford to the wagon for 37.86 and ran clean away from Jack Attack, 181.46 to 128.8. That 52.66 margin was the widest canyon of the week, and it happened even with Aaron Rodgers sittin' on the bench for 25.2. Jack Attack got 27.65 out of Josh Allen but asked the Rams defense to carry freight and got 3.0 for the trouble. Both outfits sit at 2-3, though only one of 'em is ridin' a 2 game win streak.

Drake Maye went prospectin' and came back with 45.93, the richest single haul in the territory this week, and Jrod rode it to 141.73 over densmen's 101.72. densmen got a fair 26.47 from C.J. Stroud, then watched DJ Moore post a flat 0.0 while Jalen Hurts sat on the bench for 14.5. That's 3 losses in a row and a 1-4 ledger for densmen. Jrod stops the bleedin' and joins the pay line.

sisu played a perfect hand: a better lineup would have added 0.0, not one point left in the dirt, and Jacoby Brissett's 26.94 led the way to 157.29. Dart Star Orchestra scored a respectable 126.79 and still lost by 30.5, which stings worse when you learn the Jets defense sat on the bench for 30.0 and a better lineup was worth 26.16. Dalton Schultz chipped in 2.7 for the losin' side. That's 4 straight losses now for Dart Star Orchestra at 1-4.

Warthogs are rollin', 4 wins in a row and 4-1 after takin' Justin's Bad Team 136.59 to 111.77 behind Jordan Love's 31.64 and the best defensive work in the league, Nate Landman for 15.5. And yet the Warthogs also owned the sorriest lineup card in the territory: a better arrangement was worth 31.4, with the 49ers defense parked on the bench for 26.0. Justin's Bad Team had the top man on the field in Jameis Winston at 32.87, but the Raiders defense handed over a goose egg at 0.0. Winnin' ugly still spends, pardner.

Long Howie keeps the streak alive at 5 straight and 5-0, though 100.37 is a thin margin of safety, and Jared Goff's 30.07 did most of the haulin'. Super Troopers managed 85.88 and left Kyler Murray on the bench for 22.53, but a better lineup was only worth 5.6 to them, which wouldn't have closed a 14.49 gap anyhow. Robert Henry Jr. went 0.0 for the Troopers, who drop to 4-1 and lose the unbeaten badge.

HAWKSRULE edged Scott's Hype 116.47 to 105.47 without anybody doin' anything heroic, Dak Prescott's 17.32 leadin' the way. Scott's Hype got 21.6 from Parker Washington, nothing at all from Roman Wilson at 0.0, and left Malik Willis on the bench for 17.64. Even the 9.72 a better lineup would have added still leaves 'em short of the mark. HAWKSRULE has won 2 straight, Scott's Hype has lost 2, and both sit at 2-3.

This one was a long walk in dry country. Norskes U Betcha won it 67.27 to 57.15, and Zihuatanejo's 57.15 was the lowest number posted anywhere in the league this week. Trevor Lawrence's 26.07 was about the only water in the canteen for the Norskes, while Zihuatanejo's top man was the Lions defense at 16.0 and T.J. Watt turned in 0.0. That's 3 losses running for Zihuatanejo, and both outfits ride at 2-3.

Closest race of the week: WeBleedOrangeAndBlue by 7.27, 121.1 to 113.83, with Jahmyr Gibbs runnin' off 34.35. Aeil got 31.13 from Jayden Daniels and still came up short because Mark Andrews posted 1.0 while Pat Freiermuth sat on the bench for 16.45. A better lineup was worth 15.45 to Aeil, which is more than the margin, and that is the kind of arithmetic that keeps a fella up nights. WeBleedOrangeAndBlue is 3-2 and ridin' a 3 game streak.
sign_off: 8 weeks left in the regular season and 8 seats at the playoff table, so nobody's buried and nobody's safe. One for the almanac: Jaxon Smith-Njigba of HAWKSRULE leads all 138 qualifiers in Points Over Expected at +7.2 per game. Saddle up.
purse: The commissioner's purse goes 4 deep this week: e-mans revenge takes $40.0 on 181.46, sisu banks $20.0 on 157.29, Jrod pockets $10.0 on 141.73, and Warthogs sneaks in for $5.0 on 136.59. That's 3 trips to the pay window already for sisu, 2 apiece for e-mans revenge and Jrod, and a first taste for Warthogs.
